create_GPUMonitor: create a GPUMonitor instance with a custom sampling interval to track GPU utilization
start_GPUMonitor: start the GPUMonitor background thread to begin collecting GPU and memory utilization data
stop_GPUMonitor: stop the GPUMonitor and return lists of GPU utilization and memory usage samples
print_summary_GPUMonitor: print a summary of GPU utilization and memory usage statistics from the monitor
profile_inference: profile a demo inference call with PyTorch profiler and export a Chrome trace
